planSteps.description: Open RoomTrace using the test target URL.
Open the clearly labeled sample journal.
Open Archive & restore and confirm the sample journal shows two observations and two original files.
Capture the browser download event, then click Download verified packet.
Assert that the download completes with a ZIP filename and non-empty file.
Inspect the downloaded ZIP and assert that it contains manifest.json and two original media files.
Assert that the sample journal remains active after exporting.
